reviews.title: Great airflow case with easy cable management and plenty of space
reviews.comment: This is a great case for building your own PC. I picked it up for my 11 year old son to build his first gaming PC and it worked out really well. There is plenty of space inside for components, and the layout is very well designed. It makes cable routing easy and helps keep everything clean and organized. Even for a first time builder, it was straightforward to work in. Airflow is excellent. The case is designed to move air efficiently and includes two 120mm fans to get you started. There is also support for larger radiators if you want to upgrade cooling later. We installed an RTX 5070 with no fitment issues, so there is good clearance for larger GPUs. The tempered glass side panel looks great and lets you show off RGB lighting, cooling setups, and internal components. The black finish also gives it a clean, modern look. For the price, this case offers a lot of value. It is well built, easy to work with, and performs well. Great option for both new and experienced builders.
reviews.author: JD_reviews

reviews.title: Sweet Rig
reviews.comment: This has to be the best case I have ever build in. Love that it included fans, and was perfect size for my XFX 6900x. With room to spare! Keeps my rig super cool, though I do have 8 fans in it, and was a breeze to set up. Looks amazing, and has barely any dust build up thanks to the filters. Great price too when you get it on sale! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Leon

reviews.title: Brilliantly good design in a case with great value
reviews.comment: At this price point I wasn't expecting something as good as this case. After having built in it I would certainly not be mad if priced at nearer MSRP. The build quality is there, no sharp edges, well considered wire routing and anchor points for cable management. The design comes about as close to an open-air rig as I have used which is actually enclosed. The only aspect I see as a very minor detraction is the fact that with the mesh panel placements it is impossible to hide your basement cable management. This seems to have been dealt with by way of making the rear side panel spacing a bit larger. It has been a consideration to pursue using some manner of cable sleeve, tape, or even a shrink-wrap type solution to neaten up that "shadow" footprint. Temps and noise levels are quite acceptable, build process was easy with many options, and overall, one of the best cases I have ever purchased at this price point. Would recommend.
reviews.author: M Jordan

reviews.title: a decent case from an established brand
reviews.comment: So, when this is on sale (about 60 USD) I think it is great value. This case looks very clean, nothing particularly flashy. It isn't difficult to build in unless you really care to try to cable manage, but that is true for almost all cases. Here are some pros and cons after building in it for the first time. Pros: Size - this case is a mid tower case, it houses an ATX motherboard without feeling excessively large or too small to build in. Pre-installed fans - there are two fans installed, one for the front intake and one for the back exhaust. While buying more fans is better, having some airflow regardless is nice. Cable management - one of my favorite components of this case are the options for cable management. There are many well disguised holes to slide and hide cables through. I can completely hide cables for fans. There are trays on the back with straps to tie around cables, which makes it easy to keep cables where they need to be. There is also a lot of space at the bottom for cables from the power supply, especially convenient with cable extensions. Functionality - there is lots of space and it is easy to build in. Cons: No holes for intake under the power supply - I think this is my biggest gripe with the case. I always like to place the power supply so the fan is taking in cool air from outside the case. It shouldn't matter too much, but I think the fan on the power supply might be louder as a result. Quality is not exceptional - some paint on the case chipped pretty easily. Also, the screws that hold the metal backplate of the GPU on the case don't line up perfectly and there is a small gap between the metal backplate and the PCIe slot cover. Overall, would recommend this case especially when it is on sale.
